content:
carla: Originate RC candidate rc-2.3.7 (build: artifact-2.3.7-2026-06-12). tagging for promo window. release notes: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/2.3.7
ben: SGTM. low-risk changes: batching fix, kv cache tweak, docs update. no DB migrations.
dave: @carla ping me for oncall/rollback checklist. What's the planned quiet window?
carla: Quiet window 23:00-01:00 UTC tonight. requesting pin and QA eyeball. Will run smoke + kv-warm.
deploy-bot: artifact upload complete: s3://releases/rc-2.3.7/artifact.tar.gz sha256=3fae4b9...
qa-bot: smoke pipeline queued -> smoke-rc-2.3.7 (tests: basic-generate, stream-ingest, embed-compare). ETA ~8m.
alice: Will run kv warm on staging cluster now. patchset pinned to rc-2.3.7 on staging. starting warm script: `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --candidate rc-2.3.7 --duration 5m`
ben: Quick checklist: 1) artifacts uploaded 2) smoke green 3) kv warm 4) docs/notes published 5) rollback plan ready 6) gate ack from SRE
qa-bot: smoke pipeline finished: PASS (3/3). basic-generate: ok, stream-ingest: ok, embed-compare: ok. diff within thresholds.
alice: KV warm finished. warmed ~120k prefixes, median latency unchanged. p95 latency before: 122ms, after warm: 118ms. no errors surfaced.
dave: SRE ack: telemetry looks good, infra quotas ok for promo window. I recommend canary 5% then 25/100. will monitor latency, error-rate, token cost.
eva: QA signoff: verified prompt sets A/B. sample quality spot-check OK. no regressions. notes attached: https://docs.internal/qa/rc-2.3.7-eval
carla: OK pin requested. Can someone set the candidate pin and create promo ticket? (I can't run promote from laptop until midnight)
ben: Pinning candidate now. `releasectl pin --candidate rc-2.3.7 --team eng-runtime --reason "RC origination"` -> pinned by ben at 1719009324
ben: Created promo ticket (REL-4567) and added checklist + rollback steps.
carla: Rollback plan (short): if regressions >1% errors or latency p95 > 200ms rollback to rc-2.3.6. Exec: `releasectl promote --target rc-2.3.6 --force` and `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference --to-revision=<stable>`; notify #incidents and trigger incident-runbook.
dave: Also keep the DB feature-flag off (ff:batching-new) during canary. If we see resource pressure, flip to fallback model variant via routing: `routectl set default model=redwood-2.2-compact`
ben: I'm going to run the pre-promo checklist now: docs published, pin done, smoke green, kv warm, QA ack, SRE ack. All good.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout: rc-2.3.7 -> canary 5% at 1719010800, stepups: 5% -> 25% after 10m -> 100% after 30m unless halted.
carla: Leaving a dry-run promote command for midnight operator: `releasectl promote --candidate rc-2.3.7 --window 23:00-01:00 --canary 5,25,100 --notify-channel eng-releases`
ben: Leaving sheriff notes: oncall dave, pager on. key dashboards: perf/latency-p95, errors/5m, cost/tokens, kv-hitrate. set alerts: error-rate > 0.8%, p95 > 180ms.
alice: I'll watch KV telemetry and page if mem/gpu queue backlog rises.
dave: I'll be ready for manual halt. if triggered, I will run the rollback command and announce in #incidents.
carla: Thanks all. final ask: someone run the promote during window and paste the deploy-bot responses here.
deploy-bot: NOTE: when promote executes I will post each step. For dry-run the command is a no-op.
ben: ack. I'll be standing by at the window.
carla: Dropping release notes summary in ticket REL-4567: - Fixes batching regressions under small payloads - KV cache stability tweak - Documentation updates for tool-calls
ben: minor: make sure client-compat matrix updated (sdk v1.8+).
dave: Copy. see you at the window. :thumbsup:
carla: thread locked until promotion window.
